{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out rows where biomarker_baseline is -999 (QC failure)
df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]
print(f"Rows after removing biomarker_baseline == -999: {len(df)}")

# Step 2: Deduplicate by keeping highest sample_seq per patient_id
df = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]
print(f"Rows after deduplication (one per patient): {len(df)}")

# Step 3: Filter to only the treatment arm
treatment_only = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment']
print(f"Number of patients in treatment arm after deduplication: {len(treatment_only)}")

# Step 4: Compute response rate (fraction who responded)
response_rate = treatment_only['responded'].mean()
print(f"Number of responders in treatment arm: {treatment_only['responded'].sum()}")
print(f"Response rate (fraction): {response_rate}")"}
